Advanced ATC

Sistema de aterrizaje GBAS

A precision approach and landing system using GNSS signals enhanced by a Ground-Based Augmentation System (GBAS), providing Category I–III approach capabilities (ICAO Doc 9849, Annex 10).

Quick answer: A precision approach and landing system using GNSS signals enhanced by a Ground-Based Augmentation System (GBAS), providing Category I–III approach capabilities (ICAO Doc 9849, Annex 10).

Questions and answers

What is Sistema de aterrizaje GBAS?

In this glossary, Sistema de aterrizaje GBAS refers to: A precision approach and landing system using GNSS signals enhanced by a Ground-Based Augmentation System (GBAS), providing Category I–III approach capabilities (ICAO Doc 9849, Annex 10).

How is Sistema de aterrizaje GBAS used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cambie al sistema de aterrizaje GBAS para la aproximación final, espere mínimos de Categoría II."

Definition
